findings.evidence: Line 170 `simpa only [derivativeSign_def, Function.iterate_succ_apply] using h (k + 1)` and line 270 `simpa only [derivativeSign_def, Function.iterate_succ_apply] using htail (k + 1) (by omega)` perform exactly this step by unfolding; `grep -n 'derivativeSign_def' TauCeti/Algebra/Polynomial/Thom.lean` shows no lemma covering it.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp, grind =] theorem derivativeSign_derivative (p : R[X]) (x : R) (k : ℕ) : derivativeSign p.derivative x k = derivativeSign p x (k + 1)` (proof: `simp only [derivativeSign_def, Function.iterate_succ_apply]`) in the `Basic` section, and use it at lines 170, 270 and 313 in place of the manual unfolding.
findings.issue: No lemma relates `derivativeSign p.derivative x k` to `derivativeSign p x (k + 1)`. `derivativeSign_iterate_derivative` only matches the syntactic form `derivative^[i] p`, so the single-step interaction with the file's central operation is missing and consumers must unfold the (unexposed) body via `derivativeSign_def`.

findings.evidence: Moments.lean:108 `theorem fullInverse_mulVec (obs : X → (J → SignType)) :` inside `namespace TauCeti.SignDetermination` (closed at Moments.lean:114); SignDetermination/Thom.lean:29 `open Polynomial SignType Finset TauCeti.SignDetermination`; SignDetermination/Thom.lean:49 `namespace Thom` contains only this one declaration.
findings.fix: Drop `namespace Thom` and name the theorem distinctly in `Polynomial`, e.g. `fullInverse_mulVec_tarskiQuery_iterate_derivative`, matching the existing `Polynomial.fullInverse_mulVec_tarskiQuery` (Roots.lean:51).
findings.issue: `Polynomial.Thom.fullInverse_mulVec` shares its base name with the public `TauCeti.SignDetermination.fullInverse_mulVec` (Moments.lean:108), which this file itself opens at line 29; a downstream module opening both namespaces gets an ambiguous reference. The single-declaration `Thom` namespace exists only to hide that clash, while the sibling `signCount_iterate_derivative` in the same file sits directly in `Polynomial`.

summary: The characteristic API for `derivativeSign` lacks the interaction lemma with `Polynomial.derivative` itself, so the file unfolds its own definition to take a single derivative step, and the new `Polynomial.Thom.fullInverse_mulVec` duplicates the base name of the `TauCeti.SignDetermination.fullInverse_mulVec` opened in the same file.
